{"tool": "write_file", "input": {"path": "models/mart/dim_player.sql", "content": "{{ config(
    tags=["mart", "dimension"]
  )
}}

with players as (
    select *
      from {{ ref('stg_atp_tour__players') }}
)
, countries as (
    select *
      from {{ ref('stg_atp_tour__countries') }}
)
, matches as (
    select *
      from {{ ref('stg_atp_tour__matches') }}
)
, ref_unknown_record as (
    select *
      from {{ ref('ref_unknown_values') }}
)
, wins as (
    select winner_id as player_id
          ,count(*) as num_of_wins
      from matches
     group by 1
)
, losses as (
    select loser_id as player_id
          ,count(*) as num_of_losses
      from matches
     group by 1
)
, player_agg as (
    select p.player_sk as dim_player_key
          ,p.player_id
          ,p.player_name
          ,cast(null as varchar) as player_aka
          ,p.first_name
          ,p.last_name
          ,p.dominant_hand
          ,p.date_of_birth
          ,c.nationality
          ,p.country_iso_code
          ,c.country_name
          ,p.height_in_centimeters
          ,p.height_in_inches
          ,coalesce(w.num_of_wins, 0)||' - '||coalesce(l.num_of_losses, 0) as career_wins_vs_losses
          ,case
                when coalesce(w.num_of_wins, 0) + coalesce(l.num_of_losses, 0) = 0 then 0
                else round(coalesce(w.num_of_wins, 0) * 100.0 / (coalesce(w.num_of_wins, 0) + coalesce(l.num_of_losses, 0)), 1)
           end as career_win_ratio
          ,coalesce(w.num_of_wins, 0) as num_of_wins
          ,coalesce(l.num_of_losses, 0) as num_of_losses
      from players p
      left join countries c on p.country_iso_code = c.country_iso_code
      left join wins w on p.player_id = w.player_id
      left join losses l on p.player_id = l.player_id
)
, unknown_record as (
    select cast(u.unknown_key as varchar) as dim_player_key
          ,u.unknown_integer as player_id
          ,u.unknown_text as player_name
          ,u.unknown_text as player_aka
          ,u.unknown_text as first_name
          ,u.unknown_text as last_name
          ,u.unknown_text as dominant_hand
          ,u.unknown_date as date_of_birth
          ,u.unknown_text as nationality
          ,u.unknown_text as country_iso_code
          ,u.unknown_text as country_name
          ,u.unknown_integer as height_in_centimeters
          ,u.unknown_float as height_in_inches
          ,u.unknown_text as career_wins_vs_losses
          ,u.unknown_float as career_win_ratio
          ,u.unknown_integer as num_of_wins
          ,u.unknown_integer as num_of_losses
      from ref_unknown_record u

    union all

    select cast(dim_player_key as varchar) as dim_player_key
          ,player_id
          ,player_name
          ,player_aka
          ,first_name
          ,last_name
          ,dominant_hand
          ,date_of_birth
          ,nationality
          ,country_iso_code
          ,country_name
          ,height_in_centimeters
          ,height_in_inches
          ,career_wins_vs_losses
          ,career_win_ratio
          ,num_of_wins
          ,num_of_losses
      from player_agg
)
select *
  from unknown_record
"}}
